title: Sliders that bend, dip and swell
blurb: Three <input type="range"> elements drawn as vertical strips. One bends like a string when you pull it, one is cut into bars that dip round the thumb, and one is a ruler whose ticks swell under the thumb.
question: A 2D context can't bend a picture. Can enough clipped strips of a native range input stand in for a bend, a wave and a lens, with the input still dragged natively?
result: Yes. 100 to 150 strips a frame drew at 60 paints a second in the test browser, and one last draw with no ink keeps the hit box on the straight line.
